concerns: Determinism: same inputs give the same outputs on any machine; no LLM call, no network, no wall clock inside a computation
Air-gap: runs self-hosted with no network access and no runtime dependency fetched at run time
Tool-agnostic: no GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab or Jira logic in the engine; adapters only
Tamper evidence: can a change, removal, insertion or reordering of a record go undetected?
